description: The ready WakeHuBERT streaming 'hey stemcom' model at its own calibrated default threshold (0.55).
notes: models.json at 2ac92d3b: featurizer wakehubert-int8. Threshold, smoothing and debounce come from the model's own metadata. Training data per models.json: synthetic only: edge-tts voice grid, Chatterbox voice-converted copies and OmniVoice no-reference clips that passed the speech recogniser check (the hf-stage copy of training-runs/src/omni-mixes/hey_stemcom), with one voice in ten held out; mixed into 30 s synthetic streams (LibriSpeech train-clean-100, KWS windows, AudioSet noise, RIR); streamed WakeHuBERT-tiny int8 features.
